title: Startup sometimes skips the online identity gate and blocks initial sign-in
steps: Run the unchanged Validate Gameplay Fast browser command with CMS_CHROMIUM_MULTI_CONTEXT=1, CMS_SHOWDOWN_LENGTH=3, and fresh Auth/Firestore emulators on the recorded main SHA.
Open Daniel and Nik in separate Chromium contexts; wait for the loading screen to hide.
Click #newShowdown, then attempt SIGN IN WITH GOOGLE for each manager.
expected: Both unsigned managers see the identity gate, sign in, choose their player, and pass J1.1.
actual: Run 1 signed Daniel in but Nik opened createShowdown with no identity badge/gate. Run 2 failed for Daniel in the same way. Both timed out waiting for SIGN IN WITH GOOGLE after 30000 ms with empty manager error arrays. Run 3 passed J1.1.
root_cause: Likely startup dependency race in game code, reproduced by the separate diagnostic: showdown.js is deferred before optionalModules.js and app.js. With document.readyState=interactive, initializeOnlinePlayerEntry sets its one-shot bootstrap flag and schedules a zero-delay start. That timer can run before loadRuntimeScript is defined. ensureOnlinePlayerIdentitySurface throws Online runtime loader unavailable; the catch only calls the still-undefined optional reportApplicationError, so it reports nothing and does not retry. The identity module and its capture listener never install. The existing #newShowdown listener in screens.js then navigates directly to createShowdown.
cause_confidence: high: source ordering plus an isolated 300 ms script-delay reproduction; internal timing of the two natural failures was not instrumented

diagnostic.scope: Additional startup-only browser check, separate from the three unchanged journey runs; only optionalModules.js response delivery was delayed, with no source changes.
diagnostic.repro: In a fresh Chromium context, route **/js/optionalModules.js?* and continue the request after 300 ms; load current main with the normal localhost emulator switch, wait for loadingScreen to hide, click #newShowdown, then inspect the identity API/gate and entry bootstrap flag.

fix.change: In a separate authorized code change, order identity bootstrap after its loader and error reporter are ready, retry failed bootstrap, and ensure the Start action cannot bypass identity readiness.
